THE VOID LANGUAGE GUIDES

VOID Language guides.
From syntax to async.

Explore the language, one useful idea at a time.

Start with named/default calls and application entry, then explore Unicode text, recoverable collections, generics, patterns, async work and compiler-owned tooling. The guides explain current behavior and identify features still being built.

VOID is in development. There are no public builds available yet.
